learning_objective: 🎯 Let us say thank you for all the beautiful things we have in our world!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: We say a big thank you for the bright sun, the tall green trees, and the beautiful singing birds around us.
We are very happy and thankful for the tasty and healthy food we get to eat every day.
We say thank you for our wonderful parents, teachers, and friends who love and care for us so much.

fun_activity.title: 🙏 Thank You Jar
fun_activity.instructions: Take an empty jar or a box. Every day, draw or write one thing you are thankful for on a small paper and put it inside!

quick_recap: ⭐ We should always be grateful for the beautiful world around us.
⭐ Saying thank you makes us and other people feel very happy.
⭐ We are thankful for our food, our family, and our kind friends.
